Alert.description: C4 Alert v1.0.0 (5.4). `pattern_strength` orders the queue; it is never a risk score.
Alert.title: Alert

AlertDetail.description: The complete C4 alert and its evidence as a subgraph.
AlertDetail.title: AlertDetail

AlertPage.description: One page of the alert queue; pass `next_cursor` back unchanged, null on the last page.
AlertPage.title: AlertPage

AlertSummary.description: One row of the alert queue, from the `:Alert` scalar properties (C2) and its subjects.
AlertSummary.title: AlertSummary

Citation.description: A bibliography entry (docs/sources/bibliography.yaml); `year` is null for living sources.
Citation.title: Citation

CopilotAnswer.description: An answer always carries its query and evidence subgraph; a refusal carries a reason.
CopilotAnswer.title: CopilotAnswer

DataFlags.description: What kind of data the alert touches (5.4); the UI words the alert from these.
DataFlags.title: DataFlags

DatasetInfo.description:
A dataset of contracts/datasets.yaml; `record_count` is null when the graph is unreadable,
`loaded_at` is null in v1 (C2 records no load).
DatasetInfo.title: DatasetInfo

Detector.description: The detector that produced the alert: module path, version and the evidence query's hash.
Detector.title: Detector

EntityDetail.description: One node with its names, properties, identifiers, provenance and alerts.
EntityDetail.title: EntityDetail

EntitySummary.description: What a list or a search hit shows about a node.
EntitySummary.title: EntitySummary

Evidence.description: The evidence subgraph as C2 ids, and how to reproduce it.
Evidence.title: Evidence

EvidenceQuery.description: The Cypher query and parameters that reproduce the finding.
EvidenceQuery.title: EvidenceQuery

Explanation.description: Plain-language explanation; texts describe patterns, never accusations (7.1).
Explanation.title: Explanation

ExplanationStep.description: One step of the explanation, in order, citing the evidence edges it describes.
ExplanationStep.title: ExplanationStep

GraphCounts.description: Node counts by label and relationship counts by type; both empty when unreadable.
GraphCounts.title: GraphCounts

GraphEdge.description: A C2 relationship built from a record; `id` is its C2 id, never a Neo4j elementId.
GraphEdge.title: GraphEdge

GraphNode.description: A C2 node (`:Entity` or `:Sanction`); `properties` holds its other C2 properties.
GraphNode.title: GraphNode

HealthResponse.description: `ok` exactly when Neo4j answers and both APOC and GDS are present.
HealthResponse.title: HealthResponse

NodeFlags.description: The C2 flag labels: facts a source published, never findings of NeonRadar.
NodeFlags.title: NodeFlags

PathRef.description:
A path as C2 ids: `edge_ids[i]` joins `node_ids[i]` and `node_ids[i + 1]`. The effective
share is the product of the OWNS share bands along an ownership path (Phase 2).
PathRef.title: PathRef

Problem.description: RFC 9457 problem details (`application/problem+json`); `type` is `about:blank` in v1.
Problem.title: Problem

ProvenanceRecord.description: Where a node's data came from; v1 has one per referent and `retrieved_at` null.
ProvenanceRecord.title: ProvenanceRecord

SearchHit.description: `score` orders the hits of one response only; it is never a risk measure.
SearchHit.title: SearchHit

Subgraph.description: Nodes and edges, one to one with Cytoscape elements; `truncated` when a cap cut it.
Subgraph.title: Subgraph

SubgraphLimits.description: The caps applied when the subgraph was built; `max_edges` is twice `max_nodes`.
SubgraphLimits.title: SubgraphLimits

Subject.description: An entity the alert is about; the API links it with FLAGS. Roles are typology-defined.
Subject.title: Subject

TypologyDetail.description: The catalog file's definition; `definition_markdown` is the explainer, null if absent.
TypologyDetail.title: TypologyDetail

TypologyReference.description: Where the typology is defined: catalog slug, explainer and bibliography keys.
TypologyReference.title: TypologyReference

Window.description: The time span of the evidence (UTC).
Window.title: Window

info.description: Serves the NeonRadar graph, alerts and typologies to the UI and the copilot. Errors are RFC 9457 problem details. A pattern match is not evidence of wrongdoing; the disclaimers are served by `GET /api/v1/meta`.
info.summary: Read-only API over the NeonRadar graph (contract C3).
info.title: NeonRadar API

get.description: The alert queue: priority, then pattern strength, then alert id; opaque cursor.
The complete C4 alert and its evidence subgraph.

post.description: Answer a question from a template, with its query and evidence subgraph.

get.description: One `:Entity` or `:Sanction` node, by its id or any id in its `referents`.
The neighbourhood of a node, up to `depth` hops, capped at `max_nodes`.

parameters.description: Repeatable; all record types if absent.
parameters.name: rel_types

schema.description: Repeatable; all record types if absent.
schema.title: Rel Types

get.description: Ownership chains up (owners) or down (holdings), with effective share bands.
Neo4j connectivity and versions; always 200, `degraded` unless Neo4j, APOC and GDS answer.
Versions, datasets with licences and counts, disclaimers and graph counts.

parameters.description: Repeatable; all record types if absent.
parameters.name: rel_types

schema.description: Repeatable; all record types if absent.
schema.title: Rel Types

get.description: Full-text search over names (and exact account numbers).
Every typology of the catalog, by slug.
One typology with its explainer, citations, parameters and false positives.
